title: Long-Term Securities and Banking Crises

authors: Miao, Jianjun, Shen, Zhouxiang, Su, Dongling
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We incorporate banks into a DSGE framework to study how interest rate hikes affect the macroeconomy. The procyclical bank balance sheets and long-term bond prices amplify adverse shocks, which can trigger a bank run. We introduce a macroprudential policy that can mitigate or prevent banking crises: an ex-ante permanent tax on bank holdings of long-term government bonds and reducing the tax rate in response to interest rate hikes. By contrast, subsidizing bank holdings of long-term investment bonds improves welfare when capital producers face loan-in-advance constraints.
abstract_zh: 我们将银行纳入DSGE框架，研究加息如何影响宏观经济。顺周期的银行资产负债表和长期债券价格会放大负面冲击，从而可能引发银行挤兑。我们引入一项宏观审慎政策，该政策能够缓解或预防银行业危机：对银行持有的长期政府债券征收事前永久性税收，并在加息时降低税率。相比之下，当资本生产者面临贷款预付约束时，补贴银行持有的长期投资债券能够提升社会福利。

title: Born in Smog: Immediate and persistent health consequences of acute air pollution exposure in historical London, 1892–1919
title_zh: 雾霾中诞生：1892-1919年伦敦历史急性空气污染暴露的即时与持续健康后果
authors: Eric B. Schneider
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines how acute pollution exposure in historical London (1892–1919) affected child health. I proxy acute, extreme pollution exposure using daily data on fog events, which reflect meteorological conditions where pollution emitted in the city was not dispersed across space leading to a sharp spike in pollution. I also use rich individual-level data on child health drawn from the Queen Charlotte Hospital, a maternity hospital, and the Foundling Hospital, an orphanage. I find no effect of pollution exposure at birth on birth or growth outcomes or on upper respiratory morbidity. However, exposure on the day of birth had persistent effects on health, increasing mortality risk in childhood and adolescence from respiratory diseases and raising incidence, prevalence and sickness duration of influenza and measles. There was no persistent effect of in utero and postnatal pollution exposures. These mixed results show that extreme pollution at birth had lasting impacts on specific, but also limited, dimensions of child health.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了历史时期伦敦（1892-1919年）急性污染暴露对儿童健康的影响。我利用每日雾天事件数据作为急性极端污染暴露的代理变量——这些雾天反映了城市排放的污染物因无法扩散而导致污染浓度急剧飙升的气象条件。同时，我采用来自夏洛特女王医院（一家妇产医院）和弃婴医院（一家孤儿院）的丰富个体层面儿童健康数据。研究发现，出生时的污染暴露对出生结局、生长发育指标或上呼吸道疾病发病率无显著影响。然而，出生当日的污染暴露对健康产生了持续性影响：它增加了儿童期及青少年期因呼吸系统疾病导致的死亡风险，并提高了流感与麻疹的发病率、患病率及病程持续时间。宫内暴露和产后暴露则未发现持续性影响。这些混合结果表明，出生时的极端污染暴露对儿童健康的特定维度（但范围有限）产生了持久影响。

title: Industrial internet and green total factor productivity: evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in China’s renewable energy industry
title_zh: 工业互联网与绿色全要素生产率：来自中国可再生能源行业准自然实验的证据
authors: Yi Xiao, Longjia Fu, Yuxin Xu, Xiongtian Shi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study aims to investigate whether and how industrial internet platform (IIP) adoption translates digital connectivity into measurable green productivity gains at the firm level. Utilizing a comprehensive sample of listed companies in China’s renewable energy sector spanning from 2008 to 2024, we specify a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) model to empirically test the relationship between IIP access and corporate green total factor productivity (GTFP). Our findings demonstrate that IIP adoption significantly enhances GTFP, remaining robust across multiple sensitivity tests. Mechanism analyses reveal that this enhancement is driven primarily by data network effects and digital-first innovation strategies. Furthermore, cross-sectional analyses indicate that the positive impact is more pronounced in firms characterized by lower labour intensity, higher market competition, and lower asset specificity. Based on these findings, we suggest that management should strategically integrate IIP into their internal operations. IIP providers should develop and embed real-time carbon monitoring tools to lower technical barriers for adoption. Policymakers should shift from generic subsidies to targeted interventions, offering specific fiscal incentives to alleviate the high transition costs faced by firms with rigid asset structures.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探究工业互联网平台（IIP）的采用是否以及如何将数字互联转化为企业层面可测度的绿色生产力提升。基于2008至2024年中国可再生能源行业上市公司的综合样本，我们构建了交错双重差分（DID）模型，实证检验IIP接入与企业绿色全要素生产率（GTFP）之间的关系。研究结果表明，IIP采用显著提升了GTFP，该结论在多项敏感性检验中保持稳健。机制分析揭示，这一提升主要源于数据网络效应与数字优先创新战略。进一步异质性分析显示，在劳动密集度较低、市场竞争程度较高及资产专用性较低的企业中，IIP的积极影响更为显著。基于上述发现，我们建议管理层应将IIP战略性地融入内部运营；IIP提供商应开发并嵌入实时碳监测工具以降低采用技术门槛；政策制定者应从普惠式补贴转向精准干预，通过提供针对性财政激励措施，缓解资产结构僵化企业面临的高额转型成本。

title: The Impact of Immigration on Social Trust of Natives: Evidence from the Mass Migration in China
title_zh: 移民对本地居民社会信任的影响：来自中国大规模人口迁移的证据
authors: Shu Cai, Lingwei Wu, Xiong Xiao
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the impact of immigration on natives' social trust in the context of China's mass internal migration. Combining individual-level information on social trust and county-level information on immigration rate, we employ the instrumental variable strategy and find that immigration has a significant negative impact on trust among native residents. The impact of immigration on trust is more salient for trust in weak ties than trust in strong ties, and from a compositional perspective, the impact of low-skilled immigrants is more salient than that of high-skilled immigrants. Additional analyses suggest that better public services can buffer the impact of immigration on trust, implying a key role in public policy.
abstract_zh: 本文以中国大规模内部人口迁移为背景，考察移民对本地居民社会信任的影响。通过结合个体层面的社会信任数据与县级层面的移民率信息，采用工具变量策略发现：移民对本地居民的社会信任具有显著的负向影响。从信任类型来看，移民对弱关系信任的冲击强于强关系信任；从移民结构来看，低技能移民的影响比高技能移民更为显著。进一步分析表明，更优质的公共服务能够缓冲移民对信任的冲击，这揭示了公共政策在此过程中的关键作用。

title: DP21708 Causal inference for social network formation
title_zh: 社交网络形成的因果推断
authors: Maximilian Kasy, Elizabeth Linos, Sanaz Mobasseri, Maximilian Kasy; Elizabeth Linos; Sanaz Mobasseri
official: 官方在线 2026-07-06 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops a framework for identification, estimation, and inference on the causal mechanisms driving endogenous social network formation. Identification is challenging because of unobserved confounders and reverse causality; inference is complicated by questions of equilibrium and sampling. We leverage repeated observations of a network over time and random variation in initial ties to address challenges to causal identification. Our design-based approach sidesteps questions of sampling and asymptotics by treating both the set of nodes (individuals) and potential outcomes as non-random. We apply our approach to data from a large professional services firm, where new hires are randomly assigned to project teams within offices. We estimate the causal effect on tie formation of indirect ties, network degree, and local network density. Indirect ties have a strong and significant positive effect on tie formation, while the effects of degree and density are smaller and less robust.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个用于识别、估计和推断内生社交网络形成因果机制的分析框架。由于存在未观测到的混杂因素和反向因果关系，识别过程面临挑战；而均衡与抽样问题则使推断变得复杂。我们利用网络随时间推移的重复观测数据以及初始联系的随机变异，以应对因果识别中的挑战。这种基于设计的方法将节点（个体）集合与潜在结果均视为非随机变量，从而规避了抽样与渐近性问题。我们将该方法应用于一家大型专业服务公司的数据——该公司新员工被随机分配到办公室内的项目团队中。我们估算了间接联系、网络度数及局部网络密度对联系形成的因果效应。结果表明，间接联系对联系形成具有显著且稳健的正向影响，而网络度数与密度的效应则相对较小且不够稳健。

title: DP21638 The Economic Costs of Religious Riots in India
title_zh: DP21638 印度宗教骚乱的经济成本
authors: Sriya Iyer, Dmitrii Petrukhin, Anand Shrivastava, Sriya Iyer; Dmitrii Petrukhin; Anand Shrivastava
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper estimates the economic effects of communal riots in India using a new district–year panel for 1994–2013 that combines extended riot data with nightlights, manufacturing outcomes, infrastructure, and district-level credit. To address endogeneity, we use quasi-random variation generated when major Hindu festivals fall on a Friday (Fridays draw large Muslim congregations for weekly prayers) and construct a spatially weighted instrument for local riot risk. Instrumental variable estimates show that higher riot exposure leads to sizable and persistent economic losses. A one-unit increase in distance-weighted exposure reduces nightlights by about 0.105 log points, implying a GDP decline of roughly 0.45\%. We trace several channels, including contractions in firm output and employment, fewer bank branches, less agricultural credit, and a thinner market infrastructure. Using the timing of household surveys relative to riots, we also find that trust in state institutions declines. Together, the results quantify the economic costs of communal riots and identify the mechanisms through which social conflict depresses local economic activity.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1994-2013年印度地区-年份面板数据，结合扩展的骚乱数据、夜间灯光、制造业产出、基础设施及地区信贷数据，估算了社区骚乱的经济影响。为处理内生性问题，我们利用印度教主要节日恰逢周五（周五大量穆斯林聚集进行每周祈祷）时产生的准随机变异，构建了本地骚乱风险的空间加权工具变量。工具变量估计表明，骚乱暴露程度越高，经济损失越大且具有持续性。距离加权暴露度每增加一个单位，夜间灯光指数下降约0.105个对数点，相当于GDP下降约0.45%。我们追溯了若干传导渠道，包括企业产出和就业收缩、银行网点减少、农业信贷下降以及市场基础设施薄弱。利用家庭调查相对于骚乱发生的时间节点，我们还发现对国家机构的信任度下降。综合来看，这些结果量化了社区骚乱的经济成本，并揭示了社会冲突抑制地方经济活动的机制。

title: Disentangling risk and time for optimal prevention
title_zh: 分离风险与时间以实现最优预防
authors: Yichun Chi, Richard Peter, Mengjia Qi
official: 官方在线 2026-05-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the effect of prudence on optimal prevention in two periods with Kreps and Porteus (1978) and Selden (1978) (KPS) preferences. We use consumption smoothing as the benchmark and consider risk-averse decision-makers. In this framework, prudence has a positive effect on prevention, generalizing findings of Menegatti (2009). We extend this result to risk lovers and comparative risk aversion. When saving is endogenized, the preference over the timing of uncertainty resolution becomes irrelevant for prevention, and only the curvature of marginal utility matters. This result allows us to identify a class of decision-makers who are prudent in the KPS model but whose prevention effort coincides with that of a risk-neutral agent. Our findings highlight that the structure of intertemporal preferences critically shapes the link between prudence and prevention.

title: What Happens When Dating Goes Online? Evidence from U.S. Marriage Markets and Health Outcomes
title_zh: 当约会转向线上：来自美国婚姻市场与健康结果的证据
authors: Daniel Ershov, Jessica Fong, Pinar Yildirim
official: 官方在线 2026-01-19 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies how online dating platforms have impacted marital outcomes, assortative matching, and sexually transmitted disease (STD) rates in the United States. We construct county-level measures of online dating usage using data from website-based platforms (2002–2013) and mobile app-based platforms (2017–2023). Leveraging county-level variation and an instrumental variable strategy, we show in the desktop era, a 1% increase in online dating sessions raises divorce rates by 0.50%, while in the mobile era, a 1% increase in online dating activity lowers marriage and divorce rates by 0.40% and 0.33%, respectively. We also document shifts in assortative matching. Desktop sites reduce sorting along education and employment dimensions, whereas mobile sites reduce sorting by employment, but increase sorting by race. Across both eras, we find no evidence that greater online dating usage increases average STD rates. Average effects are negative or statistically insignificant, but are positive for some subpopulations. We develop a search and matching model where technological changes impact search costs, market size, and market noise can explain our empirical findings.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在线约会平台如何影响美国的婚姻结果、分类匹配以及性传播疾病（STD）发病率。我们利用基于网站的平台（2002-2013年）和基于移动应用的平台（2017-2023年）的数据，构建了县级层面的在线约会使用率指标。借助县级层面的差异和工具变量策略，我们发现在桌面互联网时代，在线约会次数每增加1%，离婚率上升0.50%；而在移动互联网时代，在线约会活动每增加1%，结婚率和离婚率分别下降0.40%和0.33%。我们还记录了分类匹配的变化：桌面网站降低了基于教育和就业维度的分类匹配，而移动网站则降低了基于就业的分类匹配，但增加了基于种族的分类匹配。在两个时代中，我们均未发现在线约会使用率提高会显著增加平均STD发病率的证据。平均效应为负或统计上不显著，但对某些子群体而言呈正效应。我们构建了一个搜索与匹配模型，其中技术变革影响搜索成本、市场规模和市场噪音，该模型能够解释我们的实证发现。

title: Left in Charge: Political Rule and the Rise of Local Welfare
title_zh: 留守掌权：政治统治与地方福利的兴起
authors: Casper Worm Hansen, Peter Sandholdt Jensen
official: 官方在线 2026-01-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study how institutional constraints on executive selection shape redistributive policy, using a 1919 Danish reform that allowed town councils to democratically elect mayors. While the reform applied uniformly across towns, it made left-wing executive control politically feasible for the first time, particularly in towns with stronger prior support for the Social Democratic party. Exploiting predetermined Social Democratic vote shares from the 1917 election interacted with the post-reform period, we identify the causal effect of Social Democratic executive control on local public finance. We show that Social Democratic mayors substantially increased social spending, especially on poor relief and public assistance, with these expansions financed primarily through higher direct taxes. We find no robust evidence that these policies reduced local economic activity. The results highlight how removing institutional constraints on executive selection can translate latent voter preferences into concrete redistributive policy outcomes.
abstract_zh: 我们利用1919年丹麦的一项改革（该改革允许市镇委员会民主选举市长）来研究行政长官选拔的制度约束如何影响再分配政策。尽管改革统一适用于所有市镇，但它首次使左翼行政长官控制权在政治上成为可能，尤其是在那些先前对社会民主党支持度较高的市镇。通过利用1917年选举中既定的社会民主党得票率与改革后时期的交互作用，我们识别出社会民主党行政长官控制权对地方公共财政的因果效应。研究表明，社会民主党市长显著增加了社会支出，尤其是贫困救济和公共援助，这些扩张主要通过提高直接税来融资。我们没有发现这些政策抑制地方经济活动的稳健证据。研究结果凸显了消除行政长官选拔的制度约束如何将潜在的选民偏好转化为具体的再分配政策结果。
